convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load 'FatlMacd' custom indicator, and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator and library functions must be manually replicated.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts trading

other_exits: Oppposite signal closes position: short signal closes long (if BuyPosClose=true), long signal closes short (if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of deposit. Default LOT mode means MM=0.1 is interpreted as fixed 0.1 lots; other modes treat MM as fraction of margin/balance.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a 3-bar window of FatlMacd values: Value[0]=current bar, Value[1]=SignalBar+0, Value[2]=SignalBar+1. Long entry: Value[1]<Value[2] (MACD falling) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (MACD now rising) - detects trough reversal. Short entry: Value[1]>Value[2] (MACD rising) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (MACD now falling) - detects peak reversal. SignalBar=1 means signals are calculated from 1 bar ago (completed bar), providing confirmation. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates allowing independent control of each direction's open/close. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up persistent state on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The FatlMacd custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately. It appears to be a FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) based MACD with configurable smoothing (T3 default, but supports JJMA/JurX/ParMA/VIDYA/AMA via SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers - these must be replicated with proper MT5 order logic including margin calculation modes (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT). The IsNewBar class and LoadHistory function also come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so digit-adjustment awareness is needed for 5-digit brokers. Deviation=10 is in points.
